title: Hilliard Rome / Renner — ODOT Traffic Volume (AADT)
text: Near Hilliard Rome Road at Renner Road (PID 119852 planning focus), three ODOT traffic-count segment features intersect the 100-metre study buffer. OBJECTIDs 100881 and 104628 both report AADT_YEAR 2025 and AADT_TOTAL 13,851 for NLFID CFRACR00027**C (Renner). OBJECTID 62154 reports 2025 AADT_TOTAL 48,624 for CFRACR00003**C (Hilliard Rome). The two adjacent Renner segments repeat a count; do not sum them as independent traffic. These are segment AADT values, not matched five-year intersection entering volumes. No exposure-adjusted crash rate is established.
caveats: Crash records describe 2021–2025 selected-corridor history, not post-project outcomes.
A feature intersecting the 100m buffer is nearby context; not every field applies to every intersection approach.
Do not add adjacent AADT segments or treat a single 2025 AADT as five years of intersection exposure.
Speed-zone approval, roadway inventory and current posted signs are different forms of evidence.
LANES_NBR is not a count of all intersection turning lanes; THROUGH_LANES is null in the selected inventory records.
Crosswalk ADACOMPLY null means unknown, not noncompliant or accessible.
The HIN layer version and crash-attribute periods are not independently established as current.
The COTA Renner Park & Ride facility notice is a separate activity, not proof that PID 119852 construction started.
